notes: All 12 views inspected. Hardtail mountain bike with a sage frame, a suspension fork with stanchions and lowers, knobby tyres on rims with individually modelled spokes, disc brake rotors and calipers front and rear, a chainring with cranks and pedals, a chain run, a rear cassette, a saddle and seatpost, and flat bars with grips and a stem. The spokes are real geometry rather than a texture, which the close side views confirm. Front and rear wheels, the crank and a steering node are all SEPARATE, so wheel-roll, steering and crank clips can be authored.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
The chain is static geometry and will not travel with the crank clip.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
